description: This file is an implementation of the MerchantConfigurationService interface, providing methods for managing merchant configurations including retrieval, listing, saving, updating, and deleting configurations within a merchant store. It also handles JSON parsing and serialization of MerchantConfig objects.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class handling business logic for merchant configurations, extending generic service functionalities and implementing specific merchant configuration services.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a merchant configuration based on key and store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all configurations associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists configurations filtered by type within a merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing merchant configuration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified merchant configuration after retrieving it from the database.

methods.name: getMerchantConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the MerchantConfig object by parsing stored JSON value.

methods.name: saveMerchantConfig
methods.description: Serializes MerchantConfig to JSON and saves or updates the merchant configuration.
